summary: The candidate inspects the Passport exchange status before boundedJson, mapping 4xx to a default PassportError (401) and leaving 5xx to boundedJson (502); the callback catch still clears the state and verifier cookies on both paths. New tests drive both cases through the Bun handler route, and no introduced defect was found.

evidence: src/auth/passport.ts lines 317-319 cancel the exchange body and throw the default `PassportError()` (status 401) for any 4xx exchange status before `boundedJson` can turn it into 502.
The callback catch at src/auth/passport.ts lines 327-331 appends clearing Set-Cookie headers for `__Host-uos_ai_passport_state` and `__Host-uos_ai_passport_verifier` on the resulting 401.

Upstream 5xx still reaches `boundedJson` at src/auth/passport.ts lines 96-100, which throws `PassportError(502)`; tests/passport.test.ts lines 202-213 assert status 502 and `passport_unavailable` through the Bun handler route.
tests/passport.test.ts lines 189-200 drive 400/401/403/422/429 through the Bun callback route and assert status 401, `invalid_api_key`, and cleared state and verifier cookies.
